title: GTS sync prep - Elena Park
content:
Meeting: weekly GTS sync (AE + SE + CSM)
Date/Time: Wed 11/13 11:00am PT (30m) — quick cadence before Friday exec review
Objective: prioritize next actions for three highest-risk accounts, clear blockers for renewal conversations, and align on demo sequencing for Northwood Retail POC.
Attendees: Elena (CSM), Raj (AE), Sofia (SE), optional: Priya (Solutions) if time permits

Agenda (tight 30m):
- 0-5m: quick wins + FYI items (billing, minor config fixes shipped)
- 5-18m: deep-dive on NORTHWOOD, PIVOT-TECH (renewal risk), and LUMINA (expansion opp) — 4–5 bullets per account, decide 1 next action per account
- 18-25m: demo readiness checklist + who owns runbook for POC (SE tasks)
- 25-30m: confirm owners + due dates; one-line status update to send to execs by EOD Friday

Prep notes / quick account snapshots (what I need to call out):
1) Northwood Retail (POC, mid-enterprise) — current risk: POC scope creep + delayed schema mapping
- Current state: POC started 10/01, ingest pipeline now catches ~85% of product catalog items; schema edge-cases still failing tests (~15% mismatch on attributes).
- Business ask: Show 2x query latency improvements vs incumbent and proof of entity mapping reliability for holiday catalog.
- Tech blockers: SE identified ambiguous field mapping for supplier_id and variant_id; ETL owner (Northwood) has limited bandwidth.
- My proposed next action: Raj to escalate commercial buffer (2-week extended POC) + Sofia to produce a minimal mapping adapter by 11/20.
- Risks to flag to execs: if adapter not ready, POC will miss holiday validation window — potential churn impact.
- Questions to ask in sync: Can we spin up an isolated mapping job (S3->transform) under Redwood's account? Is Priya available to draft the mapping spec?

2) PIVOT-TECH (renewal Q1, ARR $210k) — medium-high risk due to slow feature delivery
- Current state: renewal conversation initiated; legal reviewing updated SOW. Usage shows 30% drop month-over-month in product LLM calls (NDAed metrics in console).
- Root cause hypothesis: recent model rollback to lower-capacity variant without communicating perf tradeoffs to product team.
- Proposed next action: Raj/Elena to schedule technical health review with customer PM and show roadmap for prioritized features (target: ship the critical reranking patch by 12/05).
- Quick ask for SE: provide before/after perf charts for the rollback (token latency/cost delta) — include in renewal playbook slides.
- Escalation: if customer pushes for discount, prepare counter-offer (3-month credit tied to success metrics).

3) LUMINA (expansion, PSD) — low risk, high upside
- Current state: pilot embedding index live; results good but need playbook for embedding refresh cadence and cost projections.
- Proposed next action: Sofia to draft embedding refresh runbook + cost estimate using Redwood Optimize recommendations by 11/21.
- Upsell opportunity: additional routes to power search and recommendations - prepare 12-month consumption forecast.

Open questions / items to surface in meeting (notes to self):
- Can we offer Northwood a short-term managed ETL assist (professional services) as a one-off to unblock mapping? Pricing thought: small fixed scoping fee + hourly. Check with SEPS pricing doc (linked).
- Confirm whether we can run a temporary mapping job inside Redwood infra for customer data (security/consent checklist). If yes, list steps and owners.
- For Pivot-Tech, need PR with rollback commit details: github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/PR-412 (Sofia to confirm).

Demo readiness checklist (for Northwood POC demo w/ stakeholders):
- Happy path query with filtered facets (yes)
- Fallback for unmapped SKUs — show transformation logs (Sofia to add sample)
- Latency benchmarks for peak catalog size (simulate + capture traces) — SRE to advise on load test window
- One-sentence success metric for demo: "<90th pct latency < 220ms and mapping coverage > 95% for top 10k SKUs"

Draft messaging for exec update (one-liner per account):
- Northwood: POC progressing; map adapter required — proposed 2-week POC extension; potential holiday risk if not delivered.
- Pivot-Tech: Renewal in motion; need to demonstrate feature roadmap and perf delta post-rollback; prepared counter-offer if discount requested.
- Lumina: Pilot strong; working on embedding refresh runbook and upsell forecast.

Action items (owner / due):
- Raj: escalate Northwood POC extension conversation with buyer (by 11/15) — if buyer ok, draft amendment for legal.
- Sofia: prototype mapping adapter (Northwood) — initial branch + test case by 11/20; confirm PR link in meeting.
- Elena (me): draft exec update + collect perf charts for Pivot-Tech (by 11/14 EOD).
- Priya: review mapping spec + advise on managed ETL offer feasibility (by 11/18).
- SRE (ask via #sre-runbooks): advise on load test window for Northwood demo (target test week 11/25).

Notes to self (scratchpad tone):
- Keep ask concrete: 1) timeline extension 2) mapping adapter delivery 3) demo deadline. No room for fuzzy asks.
- Prepare a fallback: if adapter not ready, demo plan B = limit dataset to top 5k SKUs + show transformation pipeline.
- Reminder: attach sample mapping CSV in Slack thread so SE can iterate faster (put in #gts-northwood).
- Check billing/account contact: finance contact is Grace L. — ask Raj to include in amendment thread.

Potential linked refs:
- Playbook: Confluence (Account Playbooks v2)
- Renewal ticket: JIRA-8392 (Pivot-Tech renewal thread)
- SE PR: github PR-412 (serving-runtime)

Framing lines to use if convo gets tense: "We want to meet your holiday timeline — here are three concrete options with tradeoffs and costs so you can pick which path works best."

End of prep. Will update after sync with action confirmations.

Quick personal checklist before meeting (10 min):
- Pull Pivot-Tech token-level charts from Console -> model-usage -> last 90 days (screenshot)
- Attach sample mapping CSV to Slack thread (#gts-northwood)
- Draft one-slide summary for execs (Elena) + share in #gts-leads
- Bring phrasing for managed ETL offer (scoping + price ballpark)

Unresolved: need Priya availability and legal turnaround time for amendment — flag in meeting.
